name: DSET-any-public-key
note: A key that is not the application's reaches Discord as a PING it refuses, with nothing saying why.

name: DSET-always-patched
note: Every deploy would make Discord PING the service again for a URL already right.

name: DSET-no-second-offer
note: The first PING meeting an old instance would fail the deploy.

name: DSET-no-wait
note: Offers back to back would all meet the same old instance.

name: DSET-wrong-server
note: /mod registered in a server that is the channel's id.

name: DSET-dm-channel-taken
note: A channel in no server would register /mod nowhere.

name: DSET-any-door
note: Any URL, the health door or plain http, would be offered to Discord.

name: DSET-token-in-refusal
note: A refusal printed in a public log would carry the bot's token.

name: DSET-no-user-agent
note: Discord requires its User-Agent shape; without it calls can be refused.

name: DSET-registered-anyway
note: /mod registered against an application Discord will not reach, and the deploy green.

name: DSET-refusal-green
old:
echo "::error::Discord's setup did not finish - $(head -c 300 "$err")"
            exit 1
new:
echo "::error::Discord's setup did not finish - $(head -c 300 "$err")"
            exit 0
note: A deploy whose Discord end failed would read green.

name: DCODE-first-command-only
note: A command added to the list would never reach Discord.

name: DCODE-no-admin-bypass
note: An administrator bot the channel denies would be reported lacking.

name: DCODE-everyone-overwrite-skipped
note: A channel closed to @everyone would read as open.

name: DCODE-role-overwrites-any-role
note: A role the bot does not hold would grant or deny it.

name: DCODE-allow-before-deny
old: const apply = (allow, deny) => { p &= ~deny; p |= allow; };
new: const apply = (allow, deny) => { p |= allow; p &= ~deny; };
note: Discord denies before it allows; reversed, a role overwrite allowing what @everyone is denied would not restore it.

name: DCODE-member-overwrite-skipped
note: A channel denying the bot itself would read as open.

name: DCODE-member-overwrite-any-type
note: A role overwrite would be read as the bot's own.

name: DCODE-missing-never-said
old: const missing = MOD_CHANNEL_NEEDS.filter(([, bit]) => (have & bit) !== bit).map(([name]) => name);
note: A bot that cannot post cards would deploy green.

name: DCODE-report-green-anyway
old: if (!done.missing.length) return { lines: [...lines, '- the bot\'s permissions in the moderators\' channel: everything the cards need'], error: null };
new: return { lines: [...lines, '- the bot\'s permissions in the moderators\' channel: everything the cards need'], error: null };
note: Missing permissions would be said as everything the cards need.

name: DCODE-needs-no-embed
note: A card is an embed; without Embed Links it never draws.

name: DCODE-usage-typed-again
new: default: return say('Use /mod lookup, mute or unmute.');
note: A usage text typed by hand drifts from the declared subcommands.

name: DCODE-usage-forgets-the-last
note: The usage would leave out the last subcommand.

name: DCODE-tool-not-deployed
note: A change to the tool alone would not deploy, so would not reach Discord.

name: DCODE-404-unexplained
note: The first live run's refusal would again say only "Unknown Channel", not that the id is another thing's.
